checks.claim: PGC-PYMES article 2 thresholds are asset <= EUR 4,000,000, net turnover <= EUR 8,000,000 and average employees <= 50, meeting at least two during two consecutive years
PGC-PYMES application is not determined only by size; article 2 includes exclusions and conditions that must be checked
Corporate annual accounts must be formulated by directors within three months from financial year end
Annual accounts form a unit and must show a true and fair view under the Companies Act and Commercial Code
Business books, correspondence, documentation and supporting records must generally be preserved for six years under article 30 of the Commercial Code
ICAC publishes BOICAC accounting consultations against the PGC and PGC-PYMES and the corpus requires recurring BOICAC maintenance
BOICAC continues to receive new accounting consultations in 2026, therefore static accounting knowledge requires maintenance

limitations: This validates suitability as a maintained accounting decision-support knowledge source, not every sentence exhaustively.
Tax positions, filing obligations, current registry forms, grants, sector rules, thresholds and new BOICAC doctrine must be rechecked live before use.
Audit opinions, expert valuations, legal conclusions and regulated professional actions remain outside automatic authority.
